prompt: Exactly as in the image: in the dim warehouse godown a colossal glass hourglass stands on the concrete floor between tall racks of brown cartons; a slow, steady stream of small red snack packets trickles down through its narrow waist and settles gently on the pile in the lower bulb; golden dust drifts slowly through the shafts of light from the high windows. A slow, smooth push in toward the hourglass. The hourglass, the racks and the cartons keep their shape. Everything keeps its form; no object appears, vanishes or changes shape; no text or lettering appears. Cinematic, photorealistic, smooth and slow, no handheld shake.
